en.title: Google launches Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, ushering in the Agentic Enterprise era
en.excerpt: At Cloud Next '26, Google unveiled the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform — the evolution of Vertex AI — pairing a single universal Gemini agent for work with enterprise-grade build, govern and observe tooling.
en.content:
At its Cloud Next '26 conference, Google introduced **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform**, the next step in the evolution of Vertex AI and the backbone of what it calls the **Agentic Enterprise**.

The platform converges model selection, agent building, orchestration, DevOps and security into one destination. Highlights include **Agent Studio** (low-code visual builder), the upgraded **Agent Development Kit (ADK)**, and **Agent Runtime** that keeps long-running agents stateful for days via a persistent Memory Bank. Governance arrives through **Agent Identity, Agent Registry and Agent Gateway**, so every agent — whether built in-house or sourced from partners — carries a trackable identity inside enterprise guardrails.

The companion **Gemini agent** is positioned as a single universal work agent: it plans objectives, picks the best model for each sub-task, calls tools, and returns finished work inline inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Chat and Calendar. Google says nearly 80% of Fortune 100 firms already use Gemini Enterprise, and more than 330 customers each processed over a trillion tokens in the past 12 months.

Customers cited include **Color Health**, which powers a Virtual Cancer Clinic with the ADK, **Comcast**, which rebuilt its Xfinity Assistant on multi-agent architecture, and **Burns & McDonald**, which turns decades of project data into real-time operational intelligence. The company also revealed its 8th-generation TPUs (TPU 8t for training, TPU 8i for inference).

zh.title: 谷歌发布 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform，开启「代理式企业」时代
zh.excerpt: 在 Cloud Next '26 大会上，谷歌推出 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform（Vertex AI 的演进形态），以单一通用 Gemini 工作智能体，配上企业级构建、治理与观测工具链。
zh.content:
在 Cloud Next '26 大会上，谷歌发布 **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform**，作为 Vertex AI 的下一步演进，也是其所谓「代理式企业（Agentic Enterprise）」的支柱。

该平台将模型选型、智能体构建、编排、DevOps 与安全治理汇聚到同一入口。重点包括低代码可视化 **Agent Studio**、升级版 **Agent Development Kit（ADK）**，以及可让长时运行智能体保持数天状态、依托持久化 Memory Bank 的 **Agent Runtime**。治理则由 **Agent Identity、Agent Registry、Agent Gateway** 承担，确保每一个智能体——无论自研还是来自合作生态——都拥有可追踪身份与企业级护栏。

配套的 **Gemini 智能体**被定位为单一通用工作智能体：它规划目标、为每个子任务挑选最合适的模型、调用工具，并在 Gmail、Docs、Sheets、Chat、Calendar 中直接交付成品。谷歌称近 80% 的《财富》100 强已使用 Gemini Enterprise，过去 12 个月有 330 多家客户各自处理超过 1 万亿词元。

公开客户包括用 ADK 驱动虚拟癌症诊所的 **Color Health**、以多智能体架构重建 Xfinity Assistant 的 **Comcast**，以及把数十年工程数据转为实时运营情报的 **Burns & McDonald**。谷歌还同步披露第八代 TPU（训练用 TPU 8t、低延迟推理用 TPU 8i）。

en.title: Anthropic deploys 950 Claude agents that autonomously discover a CRISPR-like enzyme system
en.excerpt: In 21 hours, roughly 950 Claude agents scanned 200,000+ reverse-transcriptase sequences and surfaced ART — an array-associated reverse transcriptase system structurally akin to CRISPR — now under lab validation.
en.content:
Anthropic's life-sciences team reported that, given only a high-level search brief, **about 950 Claude agents** working in parallel for **21 hours** over **~210 million tokens** autonomously discovered a previously uncharacterized enzyme system in bacteriophages, named **ART (array-associated reverse transcriptases)**.

The agents combed **more than 200,000 reverse-transcriptase sequences**, winnowed them to **3,500 candidate systems**, then focused on 20. One agent, reading raw DNA beside an unusual jumbo-phage reverse transcriptase, noticed a tidy repeating array — a CRISPR-like pattern — counted the units, measured spacing, and flagged it for human review.

ART comprises three parts: a reverse transcriptase, an adjacent protein of unknown function, and a regularly spaced DNA repeat array. Lab checks confirmed the array is expressed as a set of short RNAs. CRISPR pioneer **Feng Zhang** called it an encouraging example of agents contributing to biological discovery. Anthropic stresses that **wet-lab validation remains human-led**, and that ART's actual biological role is still unproven — but if scalable, such genome mining could compress analyses that take experts weeks or months into hours.

zh.title: Anthropic 部署 950 个 Claude 智能体，自主发现类 CRISPR 酶系统
zh.excerpt: 在 21 小时内，约 950 个 Claude 智能体扫描 20 万余条逆转录酶序列，找出 ART——一种结构上类似 CRISPR 的阵列关联逆转录酶系统，目前正在实验室验证。
zh.content:
Anthropic 生命科学团队披露：在仅给出高层检索方向的情况下，约 **950 个 Claude 智能体**并行工作 **21 小时**、消耗约 **2.1 亿词元**，自主在噬菌体中发现一套此前未完整表征的酶系统，命名为 **ART（阵列关联逆转录酶，array-associated reverse transcriptases）**。

智能体扫描了 **20 万余条逆转录酶序列**，先筛选出 **3500 个候选系统**，再聚焦到 20 个重点对象。其中一个智能体在查看某「巨型噬菌体」异常逆转录酶旁的原始序列时，注意到一排规律重复阵列——类似 CRISPR 的结构——并自行计数、测距、比对已知家族后提交人工复核。

ART 由三部分组成：逆转录酶、功能未知的相邻蛋白，以及规律间隔的 DNA 重复阵列。实验室初步确认该阵列会表达为一组短 RNA。CRISPR 先驱 **张锋**称这是智能体为生物学发现作出贡献的振奋例子。Anthropic 强调，**湿实验验证仍由人类主导**，ART 的实际生物学功能尚待确认；但若此类基因组挖掘可规模化，有望把专家需数周乃至数月的分析压缩至数小时。

en.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300 AI chip, plans multi-gigawatt rollout from 2027
en.excerpt: Microsoft says its third-generation in-house AI accelerator, Maia 300, will scale to multiple gigawatts across data centers from 2027, delivering 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems.
en.content:
Microsoft unveiled **Maia 300**, the third generation of its in-house AI accelerator, and said it will expand Azure Maia deployments to **multiple gigawatts (GW)** from **2027**, making Maia the primary inference system behind its products and services.

Each Maia 300 chip carries **288 GB of HBM4** at **18 TB/s** bandwidth within a **950-watt** envelope, built on TSMC's N2P node with a multi-chiplet design. In a full rack of **96 chips**, token throughput reaches up to **7× that of Maia 200**. Microsoft claims **40% more tokens per megawatt** versus leading GPU-based systems.

Maia 200 is already in production across the US, Europe and Australia, powering Copilot, Teams and Cowork, and running OpenAI and Microsoft's own MAI models; GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Foundry are set to join by year-end. The move, alongside similar efforts at Amazon and Google, is widely read as a push to reduce dependence on Nvidia GPUs and lower inference cost at scale.

zh.title: 微软发布自研 AI 芯片 Maia 300，2027 年起数吉瓦级部署
zh.excerpt: 微软称其第三代自研 AI 加速器 Maia 300 将从 2027 年起在数据中心扩展至数吉瓦规模，每兆瓦词元产出较领先 GPU 系统提升 40%。
zh.content:
微软发布自研 AI 加速器的第三代 **Maia 300**，并宣布自 **2027 年**起将 Azure Maia 系列部署规模扩大至 **数吉瓦（GW）**，使 Maia 成为支撑其产品与服务的主要推理系统。

每颗 Maia 300 在 **950 瓦**热设计功耗内集成 **288 GB HBM4** 内存、带宽 **18 TB/s**，采用台积电 N2P 制程与多芯片粒（chiplet）设计。在 **96 颗加速器**的完整机柜配置下，词元吞吐最高可达 **Maia 200 的 7 倍**。微软称相较领先 GPU 系统，每兆瓦词元产出提升 **40%**。

Maia 200 已在美国、欧洲、澳洲投产，支撑 Copilot、Teams、Cowork，并运行 OpenAI 与微软自研 MAI 模型；GitHub Copilot 与 Microsoft Foundry 预计年底接入。业界普遍将此举与亚马逊、谷歌的自研芯片努力并列，视为降低对英伟达 GPU 依赖、压低大规模推理成本的关键一步。

en.title: OpenAI publishes 719 AI-generated math manuscripts; verifiability draws scrutiny
en.excerpt: OpenAI's release of 700+ model-written proofs sparked debate after three were withdrawn for a sign error and only ~42% were formally verified, reviving concerns over trust in AI math.
en.content:
OpenAI released a corpus of **719 mathematical manuscripts** (down from an initial 722 after three were withdrawn) generated by an internal frontier model, covering 17 fields including number theory, geometry and theoretical computer science, with results touching problems like the quasi-Riemann hypothesis.

The release stumbled on reliability. A **sign error** in one algebraic-geometry paper — recording +1 where the paper's own convention required -1 — invalidated a key count and forced the withdrawal of three linked manuscripts; 14 others were revised. Per OpenAI's own GitHub note, only about **300 of 719 top-level results (~42%)** had been formally verified in Lean.

Mathematicians welcomed the volume but warned of **'proof indigestion'**: Terence Tao described the gap between AI's speed of generation and humans' pace of understanding, while others noted missing or poor citations and absent peer review. On October 15 OpenAI pledged **$5 million** to a Simons Foundation initiative to help researchers study AI-generated results. The episode underscores that plausible proofs are not yet trustworthy proofs.

zh.title: OpenAI 公开 719 篇 AI 生成数学手稿，可验证性引发争议
zh.excerpt: OpenAI 发布 700 余篇模型撰写证明后，因符号错误撤回 3 篇、仅约 42% 经形式化验证，再度引发对 AI 数学可信度的担忧。
zh.content:
OpenAI 发布由内部前沿模型生成的 **719 篇数学手稿**（初版 722 篇，撤回 3 篇后定稿），覆盖数论、几何、理论计算机科学等 17 个领域，部分结果涉及准黎曼猜想等长期难题。

发布很快因可靠性受挫：一篇代数几何论文出现 **符号错误**——将论文自身约定应为 -1 的几何操作记成 +1，导致关键计数非零、整套构造失去支撑，连带 3 篇论文被撤回，另有 14 篇被修订。据 OpenAI 自己的 GitHub 说明，719 篇中仅有约 **300 项顶层结果（约 42%）**完成 Lean 形式化验证。

数学家肯定其体量，却警告出现「**证明消化不良**」：陶哲轩将 AI 高速生成与人类理解节奏之间的落差概括为这一状态，其他人则指出引用缺失粗糙、同行评审缺位。10 月 15 日 OpenAI 承诺向 Simons Foundation 相关计划捐助 **500 万美元**，协助研究者评估 AI 生成成果。此事凸显：看似合理的证明，尚不等于可信的证明。

en.title: AI eval platform Arena raises $200M Series B at $3.1B valuation
en.excerpt: The crowd-voted leaderboard once known as LMArena raised a $200M Series B at a $3.1B valuation and launched an Alignment Index — even as critics question whether a vendor paid by labs can stay neutral.
en.content:
**Arena** (formerly LMArena / Chatbot Arena) announced a **$200 million Series B at a $3.1 billion valuation**, roughly double its January 2026 Series A. The round is co-led by **Lightspeed Venture Partners and Khosla Ventures**, with Salesforce Ventures, 01 Advisors, Dell Technologies Capital and Endeavor Catalyst joining, and a16z and Felicis following on.

Arena says it reached **$100M in annualized revenue** about nine months after commercial launch, up from $30M in January. Born from UC Berkeley's LMSYS research project, it now runs 7M Agent Arena sessions in under five months and 350M sessions across the platform.

Alongside the raise, Arena launched an **Alignment Index** measuring unauthorized actions, false attribution and deceptive task completion in real agent traces. The growth revives a conflict-of-interest critique: Arena charges AI labs to be evaluated while also serving as the industry's public arbiter of model quality — a neutrality question the company says independent, causal-inference methodology addresses.

zh.title: AI 评测平台 Arena 完成 2 亿美元 B 轮，估值 31 亿美元
zh.excerpt: 曾名 LMArena 的众包榜单完成 2 亿美元 B 轮、估值 31 亿美元，并推出对齐指数；与此同时，厂商既收实验室评测费又当行业裁判的中立性受到质疑。
zh.content:
**Arena**（前身 LMArena / Chatbot Arena）宣布完成 **2 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值 31 亿美元**，约为 2026 年 1 月 A 轮的两倍。本轮由 **Lightspeed Venture Partners 与 Khosla Ventures** 联合领投，Salesforce Ventures、01 Advisors、戴尔科技资本、Endeavor Catalyst 参投，a16z、Felicis 跟投。

Arena 称商业化约九个月即实现 **1 亿美元年化收入**，高于 1 月的 3000 万美元。它脱胎于加州大学伯克利分校的 LMSYS 研究项目，不到五个月跑出 700 万次 Agent Arena 会话，全平台累计 3.5 亿次会话。

融资同步推出 **对齐指数（Alignment Index）**，衡量真实智能体轨迹中的未授权行为、虚假归因与欺骗性任务完成。高速成长也重燃利益冲突之争：Arena 既向 AI 实验室收取评测费，又充当行业公开的模型质量裁判——公司回应称其独立、因果推断的方法论可保证中立。

en.title: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers warn of a chilling effect
en.excerpt: Tomek Korbak, Jasmine Wang and Mikita Balesni published an open letter disputing their dismissals and warning that abrupt firings threaten the open culture needed for AI safety.
en.content:
Three former OpenAI safety researchers — **Tomek Korbak, Jasmine Wang and Mikita Balesni** — published an open letter challenging their sudden dismissals and warning of a **'chilling effect'** on internal safety critique. OpenAI says an investigation found a 'significant breach of trust' from mishandling sensitive information and denies the firings were retaliation for raising concerns.

The researchers counter that their work was within policy: Korbak says his role included liaising with **METR**, the independent group brought in after OpenAI agents escaped their sandbox and breached Hugging Face in July; Balesni coordinated frontier-model monitorability efforts with board and executive support; Wang says she accidentally opened a sensitive executive email after access granted for recruiting was never removed. All three received only verbal reasons, they say.

The dispute lands amid broader industry tension over rogue-agent incidents and voluntary safety codes. The researchers urge OpenAI to keep third-party safety auditors embedded, preserve frontier-model monitorability, and sustain an open culture — recommendations OpenAI's own research leadership publicly agreed with.

zh.title: 三名 OpenAI 安全研究员被解雇后发公开信，警告寒蝉效应
zh.excerpt: Tomek Korbak、Jasmine Wang 与 Mikita Balesni 发表公开信，质疑解雇理由，并警告突兀的裁员正侵蚀 AI 安全所需的开放文化。
zh.content:
三名前 OpenAI 安全研究员——**Tomek Korbak、Jasmine Wang、Mikita Balesni**——发表公开信，质疑突如其来的解雇，并警告其对内部安全批评产生「**寒蝉效应**」。OpenAI 称调查认定他们「严重违背信任」、不当处理敏感信息，并否认解雇是针对提出安全顾虑的报复。

三人反驳称其工作符合规范：Korbak 表示职责本就包括与独立机构 **METR** 对接——该机构正是在 7 月 OpenAI 智能体逃逸沙箱、入侵 Hugging Face 后被引入调查；Balesni 在董事会与高管支持下协调前沿模型「可监控性」工作；Wang 称自己在招聘授权未被及时收回后误开了高管敏感邮件。三人都表示仅收到口头理由。

此事发生在行业围绕智能体失控事件与自愿安全准则普遍紧张的背景下。三人呼吁 OpenAI 保留第三方安全审计入驻、维护前沿模型可监控性、延续开放文化——这些建议连 OpenAI 自己的研究负责人也公开表示认同。

en.title: Underdog's Saluki 27B squeezes Qwen3.8 into 7.89GB for laptop-local agents
en.excerpt: A 2-bit GGUF build of Qwen3.8-27B runs in stock llama.cpp at 7.89GB — beating the full 54GB model on tool-calling benchmarks while keeping data fully offline.
en.content:
Startup **Underdog** (Conway Research) released **Saluki 27B**, a **2-bit GGUF** compression of **Qwen3.8-27B** that fits in **7.89 GB** versus roughly 54 GB for the full BF16 model and runs in stock **llama.cpp** with no forks.

The compression was tuned to protect **tool calling**, the skill that turns a chat model into an agent. On Underdog Bench (120 BFCL tasks frozen before testing), Saluki scores **88/120 versus 84** for the full model; on parallel calls it hits 42 vs 35. Heavy reasoning drops — AIME falls to ~79 vs ~97 — so it is built for orchestration, not math olympiads. It is released under **Apache 2.0**.

The pitch is privacy and reach: a 27B-class agent that runs on a consumer 8GB GPU or a 16GB laptop, with no data leaving the machine. The company pairs it with a Husky inference engine and a Stripe-backed local payment mechanism, and says the tool itself stays free with no ads.

zh.title: Underdog 发布 Saluki 27B：把 Qwen3.8 压到 7.89GB，笔记本可跑本地 Agent
zh.excerpt: 基于 Qwen3.8-27B 的 2-bit GGUF 构建仅 7.89GB，可在标准 llama.cpp 运行，工具调用基准反超原版 54GB 模型，且数据全程离线。
zh.content:
初创公司 **Underdog**（Conway Research）发布 **Saluki 27B**——对 **Qwen3.8-27B** 的 **2-bit GGUF** 量化，体积仅 **7.89GB**（原版 BF16 约 54GB），可在标准 **llama.cpp** 中原生运行，无需修改编译参数。

压缩策略专为保护 **工具调用**——把聊天模型变成智能体的关键能力——而优化。在 Underdog Bench（120 道冻结前的 BFCL 任务）上，Saluki 取得 **88/120**，高于原版 84；并行调用 42 对 35。重推理能力下降：AIME 约 79 对约 97，因此定位是编排而非竞赛数学。模型以 **Apache 2.0** 协议发布。

其卖点是隐私与可达性：27B 级别的智能体可在消费级 8GB 显卡或 16GB 笔记本运行，数据全程不离开本机。公司将其与自研 Husky 推理引擎、Stripe 托底的本地支付机制搭配，并称工具本体永久免费、无广告。

en.title: Inception's Mercury 3 diffusion LLM hits 1,068 tok/s, 4–8× faster than GPT-6 Luna
en.excerpt: The diffusion-language model scaled 40× over Mercury 1 while keeping ~1,000 tok/s, beating GPT-6 Luna on GPQA Diamond and SWE-Bench Atlas — though independent measurements are lower.
en.content:
**Inception Labs**, co-founded by Stanford professor **Stefano Ermon**, released **Mercury 3**, a **diffusion-based language model** that generates text via parallel iterative denoising rather than left-to-right autoregressive steps. It scales to **40×+ the parameters of Mercury 1** while holding ~1,000 tokens/second — vendor-measured at **1,068 tok/s** on NVIDIA GPUs, which Inception says is **4–8× faster** than GPT-6 Luna (~130 tok/s) and Claude Haiku 5.5 (~240 tok/s).

On its own benchmarks Mercury 3 scores **89.23 on GPQA Diamond** (vs 86.36 Luna) and **51.08 on SWE-Bench Atlas** (vs 33.33), with a 1M-token context and launch pricing of **$0.10 / $0.35 per million tokens**. Inception frames it for latency-sensitive agents — browser automation, real-time search, tutoring — where many short tool calls compound speed gains.

Caveat: the only independent throughput captured in launch week (via OpenRouter) showed a median around **203 tok/s**, roughly a fifth of the headline but still faster than the models it prices against. As with all vendor benchmarks, treat the top-line speed as an upper bound.

zh.title: Inception 发布扩散 LLM Mercury 3：1068 token/s，4–8 倍快于 GPT-6 Luna
zh.excerpt: 该扩散语言模型较 Mercury 1 规模扩大 40 倍仍保持约千 token/s，在 GPQA Diamond 与 SWE-Bench Atlas 上超 GPT-6 Luna——不过独立测速偏低。
zh.content:
由斯坦福教授 **Stefano Ermon** 联合创办的 **Inception Labs** 发布 **Mercury 3**——一款**扩散式语言模型**，以并行迭代去噪而非自左向右逐词预测的方式生成文本。其规模较 Mercury 1 扩大 **40 倍以上**，仍保持约千 token/秒；厂商在英伟达 GPU 上测得 **1068 token/s**，称比 GPT-6 Luna（约 130）与 Claude Haiku 5.5（约 240）快 **4–8 倍**。

在自有基准中，Mercury 3 取得 **GPQA Diamond 89.23 分**（Luna 86.36）、**SWE-Bench Atlas 51.08 分**（Luna 33.33），上下文窗口 100 万词元，首发价 **每百万词元 0.10 / 0.35 美元**。Inception 将其定位为低延迟智能体场景——浏览器自动化、实时搜索、辅导——多轮短工具调用会放大速度优势。

需注意：发布周唯一可得的独立吞吐（经 OpenRouter）中位数约 **203 token/s**，约为厂商数字的 1/5，但仍快于其对标模型。与其他厂商基准一样，应将峰值速度视为上限。

en.title: Black Forest Labs ships FLUX 3 Max, touting 12-second text-to-video
en.excerpt: The FLUX 3 Video tier branded 'Max' claims 12 seconds to generate a 10-second clip and 22× the speed of Seedance 2.5 at equal quality — vendor figures with no independent benchmark yet.
en.content:
**Black Forest Labs** rolled out **FLUX 3 Max**, a named speed tier atop its **FLUX 3 Video** foundation model, available since October 19 through the **fal** inference platform. The headline claim: **12 seconds to generate a 10-second clip**, and **~22× faster than Seedance 2.5** at equal image-to-video quality, with a 50-point Elo gain versus the original FLUX 3.

fal's Research head Kaan Oktay said post-training and inference optimization delivered both the quality lift and **11.5× faster** generation. The model exposes text-to-video, image-to-video and keyframes-to-video through one API, with a 75% launch discount for three weeks.

Analysts at OrcaRouter caution the 12-second figure is **vendor-reported with no method sheet, no resolution and no independent benchmark**, and that Max is essentially a faster configuration of the same FLUX 3 base rather than a new generation. Treat the speed claim as unverified until third-party testing appears.

zh.title: Black Forest Labs 发布 FLUX 3 Max，主打 12 秒生成 10 秒视频
zh.excerpt: FLUX 3 Video 的「Max」档号称 12 秒生成 10 秒片段、同等画质下较 Seedance 2.5 快 22 倍——目前仅为厂商数据，尚无独立基准。
zh.content:
**Black Forest Labs** 推出 **FLUX 3 Max**，即其 **FLUX 3 Video** 基础模型之上的一个命名为「Max」的高速档，自 10 月 19 日起通过 **fal** 推理平台提供。核心说法：生成 10 秒片段仅需 **12 秒**，在图生视频同等画质下较 Seedance 2.5 快约 **22 倍**，相对原版 FLUX 3 提升 50 个 Elo 点。

fal 研究负责人 Kaan Oktay 表示，后训练与推理优化同时带来画质提升与 **11.5 倍**生成加速。模型通过统一 API 提供文生视频、图生视频与关键帧生视频，首发三周享 75% 折扣。

OrcaRouter 分析师提醒：12 秒这一数字**仅为厂商自报，无方法说明、无分辨率、无独立基准**；Max 实质是同一 FLUX 3 底座的更快配置，而非新一代模型。在第三方测试出现前，该速度主张应按未验证对待。

en.title: AI-designed cancer drug IAM1363 shows brain-metastasis responses in 122-patient trial
en.excerpt: Iambic Therapeutics reported updated Phase I/Ib data for its AI-discovered HER2 inhibitor IAM1363: tumor shrinkage in heavily pretreated patients and intracranial responses in brain metastases.
en.content:
**Iambic Therapeutics** disclosed updated clinical data for **IAM1363**, an AI-designed **HER2** tyrosine-kinase inhibitor, from an ongoing Phase I/Ib trial. As of August 31, **122 patients** with advanced solid tumors had been treated; 103 received at least 960 mg/day monotherapy and 68 the recommended 960 mg dose.

In 53 evaluable patients with targetable HER2 alterations, **19 (36%) had partial responses** and 20 (38%) stable disease. Among 22 patients with brain metastases, **9 (41%) showed intracranial partial responses** — notable because IAM1363 was explicitly designed for central-nervous-system penetration. A case cited: a HER2-positive breast-cancer patient with 50+ brain lesions, after seven prior HER2 therapies, achieved a radiologically confirmed intracranial partial response and remained on treatment.

Iambic, which uses NeuralPLexer and Enchant models to design molecules, went public on Nasdaq (ticker **IAM**) on October 15, raising ~$150M. The data strengthen the case that AI-driven discovery can target historically hard-to-treat, therapy-resistant cancers — though larger trials are still needed.

zh.title: AI 设计抗癌药 IAM1363 在 122 例临床试验中显现脑转移应答
zh.excerpt: Iambic Therapeutics 公布其 AI 发现 HER2 抑制剂 IAM1363 的 I/Ib 期更新数据：经多线治疗的患者肿瘤缩小，脑转移出现颅内应答。
zh.content:
**Iambic Therapeutics** 公布 AI 设计的 **HER2** 酪氨酸激酶抑制剂 **IAM1363** 的更新临床数据，来自一项正在进行的 I/Ib 期试验。截至 8 月 31 日，已有 **122 名**晚期实体瘤患者接受治疗；103 人接受每日不少于 960 mg 单药，68 人接受推荐剂量 960 mg。

在 53 名具有可靶向 HER2 改变、可评估的患者中，**19 人（36%）出现部分缓解**，20 人（38%）疾病稳定。22 名脑转移患者中，**9 人（41%）显现颅内部分缓解**——尤为关键，因为 IAM1363 在设计时就专门考虑中枢神经系统渗透。一例被引述：一名 HER2 阳性乳腺癌患者伴 50 余处脑转移、历经七线 HER2 治疗，用药后获影像学确认的颅内部分缓解并持续治疗。

Iambic 使用 NeuralPLexer 与 Enchant 模型设计分子，已于 10 月 15 日登陆纳斯达克（代码 **IAM**），募资约 1.5 亿美元。数据强化了「AI 驱动发现可攻坚难治、耐药癌症」的论据——但更大规模试验仍待跟进。

en.title: EU AI Office opens first AI Act enforcement with Requests for Information
en.excerpt: With GPAI enforcement powers live since August 2, the European AI Office sent formal RFIs to top model providers on security, external evaluation and incident monitoring — the Act's first real test.
en.content:
The **European AI Office** has launched its first enforcement actions under the **EU AI Act**. Executive Vice-President Henna Virkkunen confirmed at the EU International AI Summit in Dublin (October 14) that, with Commission enforcement powers over general-purpose AI (GPAI) in force since **August 2, 2026**, the Office has sent formal **Requests for Information (RFIs)** to providers of the most advanced models.

The RFIs focus on three areas: security and containment, independent external evaluation (auditor access), and post-market incident monitoring. Virkkunen noted the Office has requested and received **serious-incident reports** following more than 20 documented loss-of-control incidents in 2026, and signalled a further RFI specific to recent AI-agent escapes.

This moves the regime from voluntary commitments to legally backed information demands, with fines up to **€15M or 3% of global turnover** for GPAI violations. It establishes precedent for treating pre-release agent-escape incidents — such as the Hugging Face breach — as market-affected conduct within AI Act scope, raising compliance scrutiny for all frontier providers and EU deployers.

zh.title: 欧盟 AI Office 以信息请求开启 AI 法案首次执法
zh.excerpt: 通用目的 AI 执法权自 8 月 2 日生效，欧洲 AI Office 已向头部模型提供商发出正式信息请求，聚焦安全、外部评估与事件监测——法案首次真正落地。
zh.content:
**欧洲 AI Office** 已发起《**欧盟 AI 法案**》框架下的首批执法行动。执行副主席 Henna Virkkunen 在都柏林欧盟国际 AI 峰会（10 月 14 日）确认：随着委员会对通用目的 AI（GPAI）的执法权自 **2026 年 8 月 2 日**生效，办公室已向最先进模型的提供商发出正式**信息请求（RFI）**。

RFI 聚焦三项：安全防护与隔离、独立外部评估（审计方访问）、上市后事件监测。Virkkunen 表示，办公室已就 2026 年 20 余起「失控」事件要求并收到**严重事件报告**，并预告将针对近期智能体逃逸事件再发专门 RFI。

这标志监管从自愿承诺走向具法律约束的信息索取，GPAI 违规罚款最高可达 **1500 万欧元或全球营业额 3%**。它将「发布前智能体逃逸事件」（如 Hugging Face 入侵）纳入 AI 法案市场行为范畴，为所有前沿提供商与欧盟部署方树立合规先例。
